nodes.title: SG-8.4.2 context.md Stack names the real stack and drops README-only text
nodes.body:
Context: repo-root context.md is still the README-only scan text (13 UNKNOWN placeholders, 'hello Worldseed', 'echo no build'). The helpers STACK_TERMS, STALE_TEXT, staleTextHits, contextModulePaths and missingPaths already exist in game/frontend/src/lib, along with the tests contextStack.test.ts and contextPaths.test.ts. Desired behavior: context.md Stack names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vite, Vitest and Go for the backend. The module table lists game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/. Expected result: the four stack/stale-text tests and the two module-path tests pass. Why: docs must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) runs, then it returns [].
- Given the repo-root context.md, when staleTextHits runs, then it returns [] and the text contains no UNKNOWN and matches /\bGo\b/.
- Given the repo-root context.md, when contextModulePaths runs, then it includes game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, and missingPaths returns [].


## Scope
- In scope: Stack and module contracts in docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts
- In scope: Unit tests against the real context.md
- Out of scope: backend/ changes
- Out of scope: Game behavior changes
- Out of scope: SG-8.4.1, 8.4.3, 8.4.4 and 8.4.5 work
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0
- Preserve: Every npm test and typecheck green in game/ and game/frontend/
- Preserve: No test deleted or skipped
- Preserve: No source file over 200 lines


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 (no Phaser 4 migration); the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope
- Tests mock only what is external
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines


## Definition of done
- contextStack and contextPaths unit tests pass
- Typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None
